# Actual four-archive rebuild comparison — 2026-10-29

Nix2.34.7 rebuilt all four exact candidate archive derivations in fresh builders and compared their NAR outputs with the retained originals: exit0,4 comparisons,17.845s. All original archive SHA256/NAR hashes, references/derivations and registered metadata revalidate unchanged afterward. A real32-byte synthetic nondeterministic build has clean exit0 and rebuild exit1 with actual different byte hashes; its original stays unchanged. This adds local archive reproducibility proof to the [four-image OCI/filesystem evidence](oci-filesystem-qualification-2026-10-29.md), not full Phase2/runtime/legal/independent acceptance.

[Exact comparison, negative control and raw logs](../evidence/t02/image-rebuild-revisions/1c48920e18407705191039ca5fe01474f2cc85603255d0b24c0aaad70767e995.json) retain source800547c/dirty attribution, complete command/tool/input identities, original build index, before/after metadata, independent actual NAR readback, per-image builder start/stop times and all raw outputs. Original24.209s image build and later17.845s rebuild are separate observations. Nix's own engine compares each fresh output to the original; identical fresh outputs are not separately retained and the independent readback hashes the original store outputs. No direct read of a discarded second archive is claimed. Native/dependency store paths are reused, while logs show actual layer/archive recreation (40 app,40 worker,51 PostgreSQL,11 gateway). No fresh native compilation is inferred.

The bounded command is `nix build --offline --rebuild --max-jobs 1 --cores 2 --option build-dir /var/lib/shop-image-scratch-VjIrVLVQ/phase2-image-rebuild-20261029-5dp80yjj --no-link --json -L ./ops/nixos#shop-app ./ops/nixos#shop-worker ./ops/nixos#shop-postgres ./ops/nixos#shop-gateway`, under the task-owned TMPDIR/XDG cache. The new exclusive build child alone was created and given0711; all existing ancestor modes stay unchanged. An1800-second outer bound applied. No repair, prune, GC, store-output replacement, real container/payload execution, provider or protected service operation occurred.

The negative control uses a new synthetic derivation whose only output is32 random test bytes. The same Nix rebuild engine rejects its different output and preserves both observed tiny files under --keep-failed; SHA256 checks independently confirm the changed bytes and unchanged original. Its final measured command sequence is0.479s, one actual negative case, with120-second per-command bounds. The first harness rejected the expected diagnostic because it searched for different wording and raised before saving the child status; raw logs are retained and no child exit is invented for that attempt. The corrected run records both actual exits before verification and requires the exact mismatch diagnostic and different hashes. These are new synthetic fixtures, not business data or credentials; their failed builder trees remain recorded rather than triggering shared cleanup.

No package pins/runtime source changed. The complete-source4/11/builds2 and locks3/8 proof plus OCI/filesystem4/19 and all42 image/deployment16/31 controls retain their exact earlier scope. The mandatory full reproducibility dispatcher still requires its complete integrated two-build/OCI/CI implementation and qualification. This local original-plus-rebuild proof does not convert every pending requirement into a pass. Native/component/standard SBOM/licence review, application-role/all-write/host-attestation transport/migration/bootstrap, executable independent replica driver, actual independent lifecycle/recovery/custody and human review remain open. [Nix2.34 build manual](https://nix.dev/manual/nix/2.34/command-ref/new-cli/nix3-build.html) defines --rebuild as rebuilding an existing package and comparing the result; the installed2.34.7 help was checked separately.
